name: Kyrat
startIntroPart1: Our great and glorious leader who has risked his life and limb to bring Kyrat out of the past.
startIntroPart2: He sacrifices everything for his adopted homeland and loves its people like his own children. May Pagan's light shine upon you all
declaringWar: You don't text for help, you cry for help. Come on, let's cry for help. If you're going to do something, you're going to do it right. Here we go. Go on! Cry for help! ... oh, pathetic... like you mean it... Help, from your diaphragm! HELP! ... wait... listen... Nothing
attacked: I'm very particular with my words. Stop. Shoot. Stop, shoot. Do those words sound the same?
defeated: Actions have consequences; I'm giving you Kyrat, but I am taking the helicopter!
introduction: Again, terribly sorry for what happened before. This is more what I had in mind. So, fresh start. Introductions. Ajay Ghale, our guest of honor. Paul, our very gracious host. The little monkey, whose name I still don't know. And I, of course, am Pagan Min.
neutralHello: Uncle Pagan here, just checking in on my favorite nephew.
neutralLetsHearIt: I hope you don't mind, but I took the liberty of having a new suit made up for you. If you are to lead Kyrat when this is all over, you're going to need a sharper look than denims and fucking sneakers, my boy. And that jacket. Oh, don't get me started. Why on Earth do you need so many zippered pockets? What do you keep in them all? Handfuls of meat? Huh, I suppose you do.
neutralNo: Got out of control. I hate when things get out of control.
neutralYes: You... and I... are gonna tear s**t up!
hateHello: Uncle Pagan here, just checking in on my favorite nephew.
hateLetsHearIt: The Golden Path says I stole its wealth, but I did no such thing! They robbed themselves for centuries instead of putting it to good use! There's a lesson for you, Ajay. People are hypocrites, and they all want someone to blame for their shit-filled lives. They never want to accept their share of the responsibility. The next time they're whining about building schools or clinics, remember they've been hiding away their fortune in dusty old monasteries for centuries!
hateNo: You had one! F---ing! Job! and you couldn't! F---ing! Do that!
hateYes: Perfect. Well, don't let me slow you down.
afterPeace: I apologize for the austerity — I sent the help home. Chances are you shot them on the way in.
tradeRequest: Don't worry about a thing, my boy. This will soon be behind us... and we'll be off on our grand adventure. Because I... have cleared my calendar for you!
